description_en: You can select a security policy type in an ACK cluster, configure the related enforcement actions and scope, and create and deploy a policy instance. You can call the DescribePolicyInstances operation to query the details of specified policy rule instances in a cluster, such as the policy description and governance level
description_zh: 您可以在ACK集群中选择安全策略类型，配置相关实施动作、作用范围等，创建并部署一个策略实例。您可以调用DescribePolicyInstances接口，获取集群中指定策略规则实例的详细信息，例如策略描述、治理等级等
name: DescribePolicyInstances

The governance action of the rule. Valid values:

`deny`: Blocks non-compliant deployments.

`warn`: Generates an alert

policy_scope.description_en:
The scope of the policy instance.

By default, an asterisk (*) indicates all namespaces in the cluster.

Otherwise, the names of the namespaces to which the policy applies are returned. Multiple namespaces are separated by commas (,)
policy_scope.description_zh:

默认"*"代表集群所有命名空间。

否则返回作用Namespaces名称，多个Namespaces以逗号（,）分隔
policy_scope.title_en: 策略实例实施范围： 默认"*"代表集群所有ns 否则返回作用namespaces名称，多个namespaces以逗号分隔
